body.name: \mathcal M_{H,s}
body.type: high-level recursive SCM with a residual coordinate
body.def: \(\mathcal M_{H,s}=\langle(U_C,U_X,B,S),(C,H,Z_s,Y),(C=U_C,H=h,Z_s=g_s(C,S),Y=B_{C,\delta_X(H,Z_s)}),P_R\rangle\); the observed high-level state is \(C,H,Y\) and \(Z_s\) is the compatible residual coordinate.
